marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major US chipmakers reported Q2 revenue growth exceeding market consensus by 15%, driven by robust enterprise demand for next-generation AI accelerators.
marketLayer.inference: Capital expenditure among tech hyper-scalers remains resilient, providing strong tailwinds for AI hardware suppliers across both US and Asian supply chain stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential export compliance updates and persistent packaging capacity constraints.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech Giants & Cloud Monetization
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index gained 1.8%, underpinned by earnings previews indicating accelerated revenue growth in cloud computing and enterprise AI services.
marketLayer.inference: Chinese technology leaders are demonstrating tangible monetization of AI investments, supporting a valuation re-rating for major platform operators.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Domestic price competition in enterprise cloud services and broader macroeconomic consumption trends.

marketLayer.title: Global Macro & Monetary Policy Expectations
marketLayer.fact: US core inflation metrics signaled moderate cooling, reinforcing market pricing for a potential Federal Reserve rate cut in late Q3.
marketLayer.inference: A lower yield environment is likely to improve liquidity for Hong Kong equities and sustain momentum in high-growth US tech sectors.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Labor market resilience potentially keeping service sector inflation stickier than anticipated.

marketLayer.title: China New Energy Vehicles (NEV) Export Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed Chinese EV manufacturers reported strong early Q3 export volume increases, compensating for aggressive domestic price cuts.
marketLayer.inference: International market expansion is emerging as a critical driver for margin defense among top-tier EV brands.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving trade policies and anti-subsidy tariff investigations in key overseas markets.
